text:
morgan: Heads-up — running an audit after last night's sprint. We saw ~18 temporary admin elevations that didn't auto-revoke.
sam: oof. where did they come from? scheduled maintenance or manual? :thinking_face:
taylor: Most are `team-ops-temp-admin` grants from the emergency playbook. They should have TTLs set on the role binding.
jess: I pulled the logs. Looks like the revocation job errored at 03:12 UTC. `cron-revoker` threw a 500 to KMS on key unwrap.
alex: KMS error? which key/alias? could be a permission stove pipe.
jess: Alias `alias/redwood/revoker` — error in audit: "AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt"
infra-bot: deploy failed for revoker v2.1.3 — rolling back to v2.1.2
morgan: If KMS denied decrypt, revoker couldn't read the token encryption key and skipped TTL processing. That explains the no-revoke.
sam: Can we revoke the outstanding sessions manually? We should treat these as active admin entitlements until cleared.
taylor: I ran an audit query to enumerate active grants:

```
SELECT grantee, role, granted_at, expires_at FROM rbac_grants
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%' AND expires_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```

Found 18 rows — 12 human, 6 svcacct.
jess: For svcacct ones I can rotate keys and remove bindings. For humans, suggest immediate reversion of temp roles and send MFA prompt.
alex: I'll open a short maintenance to patch revoker pod and ensure KMS permissions include `kms:Decrypt` for the revoker service account.
morgan: Priority order: 1) manual revoke of human temp grants, 2) rotate/rebind svcacct keys, 3) deploy patched revoker + dry-run locally, 4) backfill audit and confirm no additional missed revokes.
sam: I'll handle #1 — running a bulk revoke script now. Reply to the users with incident note.
taylor: I'll take #2 and coordinate with infra for key rotation. tagging @alex as primary.
alex: On it — checking IAM policy. Probable diff: missing `kms:Decrypt` on the CMK key policy for the revoker SA.
infra-bot: key-rotation job queued: cmk-042 -> rotation-window next 10m
jess: Quick PSA: if anyone has active elevated sessions, please drop them and re-request. We'll track exceptions.
morgan: Also: add a canary test to revoker that performs a KMS decrypt against a test blob before proceeding — fail early.
sam: noted. I'll add a unit/integration test and a synthetic monitor alert for revoker errors.
taylor: after rotation I'll run the revoke job in dry-run and share the output here.
alex: timeline estimate: patch + deploy in ~45m, manual revokes in ~15m, key rotation ~30m.
infra-bot: deploy completed for revoker v2.1.2 (rollback) — v2.1.3 held for debug
morgan: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated when each step completes. I'll file a short postmortem snippet and link it here once we've verified backfill.
sam: bulk revoke done — 12 human grants removed, notify messages sent.
taylor: svcacct rotations in progress. 3/6 done.
jess: backfill job started to annotate missed revokes in audit logs.
alex: patched revoker image built with KMS policy fix, running canary.
infra-bot: canary-k8s-revoker passed 3/3 decrypt checks
morgan: Great. Schedule follow-up review in weekly RBAC sync to add TTL unit tests and a runbook update.
sam: ack. closing loop once audit backfill completes.
jess: audit backfill finished — all 18 annotated and closed. no other gaps found.
morgan: Closing the incident. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
